scriptLines: bfsEntryInformationsCsvGz derive(special_apply_max_line = iif(isNull(special_apply_max_line) || trim(special_apply_max_line) == '', toDecimal(null()), toDecimal(special_apply_max_line, 10, 0)),
terminal_restrict_term = iif(isNull(terminal_restrict_term) || trim(terminal_restrict_term) == '', toDecimal(null()), toDecimal(terminal_restrict_term, 3, 0))) ~> convertToDecimal
bfsServiceSummaryAccessoriesCsvGz derive(num1 = iif(isNull(num1) || trim(num1) == '', toDecimal(null()), toDecimal(num1, 6, 0)),
bfsServiceSummaryDevicesCsvGz derive(linenum = iif(isNull(linenum) || trim(linenum) == '', toDecimal(null()), toDecimal(linenum, 10, 0)),
offered_price_step3 = iif(isNull(offered_price_step3) || trim(offered_price_step3) == '', toDecimal(null()), toDecimal(offered_price_step3, 10, 0))) ~> derivedColumn1
